svg.title: SynapseNet map — the cell, the mesh, the ledger
svg.text: the cell, the mesh, the ledger

g.title: YOU: The operator in the cell. ~/.synapsenet/synapsenet.conf, wallet.dat + wallet.key, poe/poe.db lib models/*.gguf
Desktop: synapsenet-app Tauri, JSON RPC same process. MAIN WALLET SEND BLOCKS KNOW NAAN, HARVEST INTEL MSG IDE NET RENT SET, tauri-app/src/app/App.svelte
libsynapsed.so: C++ engine in-process with the desktop. session Tor PoE v1 Transfer, NAAN harvest GGUF mouth MSG sealed, src/ide/synapsed_engine.cpp
session Tor: App-owned daemon, not Tor Browser. ADD_ONION NEW DiscardPK, ephemeral v3 onion, src/core/tor_process_guard.cpp
Tor mesh: Fail-closed peer transport. onion :8333 no clearnet fallback, seed only from synapsenet.conf, SOCKS POE_* stealth tx
PoE v1: Peer knowledge consensus, not an LLM. poe.db entries votes finalize, POE_ENTRY POE_VOTE, POE_RECIPE POE_RECIPE_REPLAY
Wallet: Local wallet and claims. wallet.dat stealth SEND, RingCT coinbase key image, src/core/wallet.cpp
NAAN: The miner: lymph then recipe. Tor first public pages, gate solver / OCR / GGUF, scar of a door no faucet mint
Local GGUF: Mouth isolation: talks, never judges. prompt / score from the model, cannot vote or finalize, weights stay on disk
MSG: Sealed messages to a peer onion. ML-KEM + X25519 if kem_pk, else crypto_box_seal, NET map still shows YOU
desktop cell: Full cell: peer + miner + validator. poe_pk NAAN stealth wallet, PEX onions to the VPS, 2 of 2 / majority
VPS mesh-peer: Always-on mailbox, not a desktop. mesh-peer.py stable onion, synapsed-poe-mesh votes if poe_pk, no stealth NGT on the mailbox
PEX: Onions learned over Tor, not baked in. desktop cell <-> VPS, seed_nodes in synapsenet.conf, rotate the example, not the .so
majority: PoE is votes, not a roll call of onions. two full cells: both must vote, then 2 of 3, 3 of 5, ..., thin mailbox without poe_pk stays mail
IDE CODE / TEXT: Human knowledge entry from the IDE. title + body PoW 12 <= 64 KiB, POE_ENTRY to VPS + other cells, snippet.rs in IDE
RECIPE: Hash of a public page, never the bytes. lymph on the same machine, hash mismatch dies here, locator + selector + body hash
POE_VOTE: Each full cell casts its own vote. after mouth isolation, GGUF cannot vote, src/core/poe_v1.cpp
two clocks: Cite DAG orders recipes. Tor arrival time does not vote, quorum of absence = not seen, never as false
FINALIZED: Accepted knowledge, three exits. KNOW card stays public, RingCT coinbase 0.10 stealth, scar: class, UTC day, method
KNOW: Author, amount, rewardId are public. ACTIVE / SLEEPING / RETRACTED, seniority ring: prove N, not which N, KNOW card stays public
RingCT: Mint is coinbase; spend is stealth. CODE/TEXT or RECIPE after 2 of 2, SEND: SN + 128 hex MLSAG-2, Pedersen range64 key image Tor
scar: The organism remembers a public door. gate class UTC day method class, no cookie no session, INTEL may show the class
NGT: Earn-or-transfer. No in-protocol buy.. size penalty after 8 KiB, first reward sweep secp, later ring, Dilithium when liboqs is real
HARVEST: What the agent pulled, Tor SOCKS only. tick -> gate -> lymph -> RECIPE, HARVEST log no NGT from a faucet, NGT only after finalize
NET: YOU sit in the center of the map. wheel zooms drag pans, share the session onion, it is new each launch
SET: Tor only. No clearnet button.. Tor or Tor + Bridges, model resources NAAN profile, quantum status is read-only
